summary: First-finish smoke test for EDS PIXEL. Backend auth (admin + tecnico), role-based access (admin-only /api/auth/users returns 403 for tecnico, 200 for admin), ticket creation (EDS-* code + PIN autogenerated), public tracking (200 for existing code, 404 for invalid), sales creation, daily report and settings endpoints all respond correctly. Frontend: admin login works, dashboard renders KPIs (denaro-fermo, piano-riscatto, business-tip), nav-settings is visible for admin and hidden for tecnico, tickets registry lists tickets with all 6 action buttons (whatsapp, status, print-a4, print-label, edit, delete), status + edit dialogs open correctly, POS checkout (contanti) succeeds and updates daily total, public tracking page shows track-card for valid code and track-not-found for invalid code without authentication.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin and tecnico return JWT
POST /api/tickets creates ticket with code EDS-* and 4-digit pin
POST /api/sales creates POS sale with code POS-*
Frontend admin login + dashboard render (KPIs, denaro-fermo, piano-riscatto, business-tip)
nav-settings visible to admin, hidden for tecnico
Tickets page lists tickets with all 6 action buttons (whatsapp/status/print-a4/print-label/edit/delete)
POS: add items (idrogel + cuffie), total updates to 40,00€, checkout pay-contanti succeeds (dashboard shows 50,00€ sales after)
Public tracking /?track=EDS-... shows track-card without auth; invalid code shows track-not-found
NewTicket form exposes all expected data-testids (customer_name/phone/email, device_brand/model/color, imei, pin, pattern, issue, accessories, conditions, estimate, deposit, notes) + btn-save-ticket

failed.issue: action-whatsapp-* element does not expose an href attribute (returns null). Likely a <button> with onClick -> window.open('https://wa.me/...') instead of an anchor tag. Functional behavior probably still correct but cannot verify href via DOM.

action_items: Optional: render action-whatsapp-* as <a href='https://wa.me/<phone>?text=...' target='_blank'> instead of a button, so the wa.me URL is inspectable in the DOM and opens in a new tab natively. Not blocking.
